description: CDASH SUNCF (C83004) -- Substance Use Never/Current/Former Classification. All 3 official values, applied to both ALCSTAT and SMOKSTAT (both studies already reused the same underlying list for these two fields, just under different list names -- su_stat in Precision, stat in Detroit -- and used lowercase values that don't match the real CDISC submission values).
source: NCI EVS CDISC CDASH Controlled Terminology, SUNCF C83004, fetched 2026-09-28 from https://evs.nci.nih.gov/ftp1/CDISC/SDTM/CDASH%20Terminology.pdf
